title: 「Although 句」句型
titleEn: Using Although to express concession and contrast
formula: Although + subject + verb + other information, subject + verb + other information

formulas.formula: Although + subject + verb + other information, subject + verb + other information

example: Although the idea sounds simple, the execution is highly demanding.
exampleZh: 雖然這個想法聽起來很簡單，但執行起來要求很高。

examples.en: Although the idea sounds simple, the execution is highly demanding.
examples.zh: 雖然這個想法聽起來很簡單，但執行起來要求很高。
examples.highlight: Although the idea sounds simple, the execution is highly demanding.

zh: Although 用來連接兩項真實但帶有意外對比的資料。
第一部分說明一個情況，第二部分則說明一個在該情況下仍然成立、甚至有點出乎意料的結果。

rules.en: Although must be followed by a complete clause.
rules.zh: Although 後面必須接完整子句。

rules.en: When an Although clause comes at the beginning of a sentence, add a comma after it.
rules.zh: Although 子句放在句首時，後面要加逗號。
examples: Although it was raining, we went outside.

rules.en: Do not use although and but together in the same sentence.
rules.zh: 同一句中不要同時使用 although 和 but。
examples: Incorrect: Although it was raining, but we went outside.
Correct: Although it was raining, we went outside.

sourceOmissions: The PDF gives the Important Rules explanations in Chinese only; the English rule fields and lesson titleEn are editorial translations.

benefits.en: It connects two contrasting facts clearly.
benefits.zh: 它能把兩項看似相反或出乎意料的事實清楚地連接起來。

benefits.en: It makes your English sound smoother.
benefits.zh: 它能避免使用太多零碎短句，令英語表達更加流暢。

benefits.en: It helps you explain balanced ideas.
benefits.zh: 它能幫助你同時考慮兩方面，特別適合日常解釋、意見寫作、DSE及IELTS。

en: Rewrite each sentence using Although to express contrast.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用 Although 改寫以下句子，以表達讓步或對比。
